premium_rules.title: Auto Premium Calculation — Simplified Sample Formula
premium_rules.content:
Fictional, simplified illustration of how a base auto premium might
                        be adjusted by rating factors. Not a real rating plan.

                        base_premium = $800 (fictional base rate for this sample tier)

                        final_premium = base_premium
                            * risk_tier_factor   (A=0.85, B=1.00, C=1.35 -- fictional)
                            * vehicle_age_factor  (0-3 yrs=1.10, 4-8 yrs=1.00, 9+ yrs=0.90 -- fictional)
                            * territory_factor    (varies by fictional rating territory, 0.9-1.3)
                            * discount_factor     (multi-policy 0.90, good-driver 0.85 -- fictional)

                        Example (fictional): base $800 * tier B (1.00) * vehicle age 4-8 (1.00)
                        * territory (1.05) * multi-policy discount (0.90) = $756.00/year.
